summary: Learn to design and price agricultural climate risk insurance products that protect farmers and portfolios. Enroll your team today.
lede: Weather insurance for agriculture links climate and yield data with product design to address production and revenue risks. For agricultural insurance, finance, and climate-risk professionals, the training develops practical skills in mapping exposure and losses, designing weather-index and area-yield covers, and calculating premiums and payouts. Participants also examine basis risk, portfolio risk layering, and farmer-facing distribution and claims processes.
audienceIntro: This agricultural climate risk insurance training is designed for professionals who already engage with agricultural risk, insurance, or climate programs and now need to structure robust, climate-linked insurance solutions for farming systems and agri-finance clients.
audience: Climate and Disaster Risk Finance Specialists
modules: Agricultural Climate Risk and Insurance Foundations
Measuring Agricultural Climate Risk and Losses
Weather Index and Area-Yield Product Design
Pricing, Premium Setting, and Risk Layering
Reinsurance, Sovereign Risk Finance, and Aggregation
Distribution, Partnerships, and Farmer Value Propositions
Regulation, Consumer Protection, and Data Governance
Monitoring, Evaluation, and Portfolio Performance Management
Integrating Insurance into Agricultural Risk Management Strategies
Business Case, Financial Modeling, and Executive Communication
prerequisites: This is an intermediate course. You should have: (1) working knowledge of basic insurance concepts such as premium, sum insured, deductible, and claims ratio; (2) experience in at least one of these areas: agricultural finance, crop or livestock insurance, climate or disaster risk management, or agricultural development programming; and (3) comfort working with spreadsheets to manipulate basic datasets and run simple calculations. Coding is not required. Advanced concepts such as probabilistic risk modelling and parametric index optimization are taught at operational application level, focusing on how to specify, commission, interpret, and use results rather than how to engineer the underlying models. You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software installed; all other tools, sample datasets, and templates are provided during the course.
